answer: One horizon ties the agent to the deed, one whisper prices the lie, and one shale keeps the deed on record. The gate asks for Derby flowermaker licence with flowermakers endorsement before the first reward — a licence flowermakers renew after fitting audits. The price is time: 2 years and 3000 fitting audits per identity, and time is the one thing a farm cannot print. The farm cannot afford all three.
